statement: There are n items. Item i has weight weights[i] and value values[i]. A knapsack can carry a total weight of at most capacity.
Each item is either packed whole or left out; it cannot be split or packed twice.
Return the largest total value of a set of items whose total weight is at most capacity.

examples.explanation: Pack the items of weight 1 and 4: weight 5, value 5 + 8 = 13. No other choice that fits is worth more.
The two items together weigh 5, which is too much. The better single item is the one worth 5.
